about.title: Most projects need a designer and a developer. I'm both.
about.p1: I'm a Systems Engineer who started out turning client requirements into website frontends. Since then I've rebuilt job boards and institutional sites, designed a digital magazine, led IT at an agency, run the sites of a telecom operator in two countries, and today I build the websites and web apps of a quick-service restaurant group across Mesoamérica.
about.p2: Because I design what I build, nothing gets lost between the mockup and production.
about.aside: Away from the keyboard: coffee, comics and video games.

food.name: Food service
food.body: Websites and web apps for a quick-service restaurant group across Mesoamérica: structure, implementation and ongoing development.

telecom.name: Telecommunications

trade.name: Trade and export
trade.body: Redesign and development of a new digital magazine for a national exporters' association.

employment.name: Employment platforms
employment.body: A new version of an institution's job board, redesigned and rebuilt, plus all of its websites.

agencies.name: Digital agencies
agencies.body: Websites and apps for agency clients, from gathering requirements to design, frontend and full builds.

capabilities.title: What I can build
capabilities.lead: Six things I take from first sketch to production. Open one to see what it involves and what I build it with.

websites.name: Websites
websites.body: Institutional sites and digital publications, designed and developed, then kept healthy as a webmaster.

webapps.name: Web applications
webapps.body: Job boards and business web apps with real users behind them, from the data model to the last interface state.

mobile.name: Mobile applications
mobile.body: Apps designed and developed for clients, with the same care for the interface as for the code behind it.

interfaces.name: Interfaces and UX
interfaces.body: Wireframes, experience maps, visual identity and interaction design that a developer can actually build, because I'm that developer.

architecture.name: Code architecture and security

infrastructure.name: Infrastructure and care
infrastructure.body: Hosting, domains, email, SSL certificates, monitoring and backups, so whatever launches keeps running.

evolution.title: Still compiling.
